description: JSON Schema 2020-12 projection of every type.

supports.description: Object types with required members, nullability, bounds, enums, decimal precision, arrays, references and discriminated unions.

unsupported.reason: A pinned external schema is referenced, not inlined.
A decimal travels as a string so no digit is lost to binary floating point; JSON Schema bounds such a value only by sign, precision and scale, not by an arbitrary minimum or maximum.

tooling.purpose: Compiles the projected schema as an independent JSON Schema 2020-12 validator.

proofLimits: Compilation proves the schema is valid JSON Schema 2020-12; it does not prove that producers emit conforming payloads.

checks.claim: The projected schema compiles under Ajv 2020-12 strict mode, accepts a generated conforming instance of every type and rejects an instance missing a required member.
checks.limits: Schema validity and generated samples only.
